##### Project General Facts

Jumeirah Residences represents a benchmark in branded waterfront living, combining refined architecture, luminous design, and the timeless values of Jumeirah hospitality. Rising gracefully from the water’s edge, the tower is conceived as a sculptural landmark that captures light throughout the day, creating homes that feel calm, elevated, and deeply personal. The collection includes spacious apartments and exclusive penthouses, each designed to offer a sense of privacy, openness, and effortless luxury shaped by panoramic views of the sea and skyline. 

The lifestyle experience is enriched by a thoughtfully curated selection of amenities that reflect balance, wellbeing, and refined social living. Residents enjoy elegant arrival spaces, residents’ lounges, private event rooms, libraries, and screening rooms designed for both connection and retreat. Wellness and recreation are central to daily life, with indoor and outdoor swimming pools, state-of-the-art fitness facilities, treatment suites, landscaped sky decks, and dedicated spaces for families and younger residents, all delivered with the discretion and attentiveness synonymous with the Jumeirah brand.

Interiors are crafted as private sanctuaries, defined by understated luxury, natural materials, and meticulous attention to detail. Floor-to-ceiling windows flood living spaces with natural light, while refined finishes and bespoke detailing create warmth, depth, and a sense of calm. Kitchens are seamlessly integrated into the living areas, combining elegant cabinetry, premium surfaces, and functional layouts that support both everyday living and refined entertaining. Decorative elements follow a sophisticated, contemporary design language that feels timeless, tactile, and quietly luxurious.

##### Location Description and Benefits

Al Maryah Island is one of Abu Dhabi’s most prestigious and forward-thinking waterfront destinations, known for its seamless blend of business, culture, lifestyle, and leisure. The island offers a rare balance between vibrancy and tranquility, allowing residents to enjoy a dynamic urban environment while remaining surrounded by calm waterfront promenades and open views.

The area provides exceptional access to globally recognized cultural institutions, luxury retail destinations, fine dining experiences, and leading healthcare and educational facilities. Its pedestrian-friendly design and strong infrastructure support a lifestyle where daily needs, professional commitments, and leisure pursuits are effortlessly connected, enhancing both convenience and quality of life.

With its refined urban planning, waterfront setting, and central positioning within Abu Dhabi, Al Maryah Island offers an environment defined by elegance, accessibility, and long-term value. The district stands out as a destination where contemporary city living unfolds with confidence, privacy, and enduring appeal.
